meta.description: Registry of verified static (download-only) parcel dataset sources. See models.py's module docstring for why an entry may only be added after a human (or an agent with real network access) has actually opened the download_url, confirmed the format and CRS, and identified the true parcel_id_field -- guessing any of those produces confidently-wrong data, the same failure mode js/parcel/registry.js already refuses for live services.

sources.geographic_coverage: Statewide -- all Vermont towns (338,862 parcel records as of the 2026-08-13 live ingestion run, includes stacked polygons for one-to-many land/Grand-List relationships per the publisher's own documentation)
sources.notes:
Live-verified via 5 rounds of disposable diagnostic dispatches (GitHub Actions, 2026-08-13): item id 09cf47e1cf82465e99164762a04f3ce6 (Feature Service, owner Services_VCGI), native layer at services1.arcgis.com/BkFxaEFNwHqX3tAw/.../FeatureServer/0 (native CRS wkid 32145 / VT State Plane meters). The download_url above requests the Esri-reprojected WGS84 (EPSG:4326/CRS84) GeoJSON export via ArcGIS Hub's download API (spatialRefId=4326 is required -- omitting it returns HTTP 400).

FIRST REAL INGESTION RUN (2026-08-13, run 31723847599) surfaced two real bugs, both now fixed here: (1) health=SCHEMA_CHANGED, why='missing expected fields: [Shape__Area, Shape__Length]' -- ogr2ogr's GeoJSON writer normalizes ArcGIS's double-underscore Shape__Area/Shape__Length to single-underscore SHAPE_Area/SHAPE_Length (confirmed by inspecting a real committed output chunk); expected_fields must describe the POST-conversion schema (what pipeline.py's _check_schema() actually checks against converted_path), not the raw source's field names, so it's corrected here. (2) duplicate_count=23,558 of input_count=338,862 -- SPAN is the land-parcel identifier and is NOT unique per feature by the publisher's own documented design (the item description explicitly calls out a 'stacked-polygon effect': one land parcel with N Grand List records, e.g. 15 mobile homes on one lot, returns 16 identical-geometry features sharing one SPAN but each with its own GLIST_SPAN). Using SPAN as parcel_id_field caused convert.py's per-feature dedup to wrongly discard every stacked feature but the first. parcel_id_field is now GLIST_SPAN, the true unique-per-feature key. No COUNTY field exists in this schema -- Vermont's local government units are towns (TOWN/TNAME), not counties; county is not a native GIS join key for this dataset. This is a large statewide file (~213MB); data/parcel_pipeline/static_ingestion/chunk.py is designed to split arbitrarily large FeatureCollections into web-sized geographic chunks after conversion, so this is within the pipeline's intended scope, not a special case.
